title: Record maintenance.
bodyText: The department, pursuant to chapter 91, shall adopt requirements for the establishment and maintenance of records relating to underground storage tanks and tank systems.
bodyHtml: [§342L-7.5]  Record maintenance.  The department, pursuant to chapter 91, shall adopt requirements for the establishment and maintenance of records relating to underground storage tanks and tank systems. [L 1992, c 259, pt of §1]
